title: Kinds
summary: Explains UI System kinds (shop, app, website, booking, portfolio): what each is for, the pages drawn first, scope questions, and how kind pairs with preset and brand.
notes: Reference doc with a definition table; light SPEC signals (ui.config.json `kind` field, `ui-system init --preset --kind` CLI, source of truth in KINDS) but no schema/contract, so DOC. Embeds owner rules worth carrying as context: kind is picked separately from preset, sets no values, works in any preset; order of work is preset -> kind -> brand. Filename lacks the SHA-256 path hash: no shell available to compute it, so the path-derived suffix 'docs-path' is used instead.
